definitions.explanation: A three-wheeled vehicle, typically a small pedal-powered vehicle for young children, or a three-wheeled motorized vehicle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三輪車|さんりんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}っている→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: A child is riding a tricycle.

examples.japanese: {三輪車|さんりんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安定|あんてい}→安定：01703_antei⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A tricycle is more stable than a bicycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{三輪車|さんりんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: When I gave a red tricycle as a birthday present, the child was delighted.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧ (three), {輪|りん} (wheel), and ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle). Follows the same pattern as ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧ (bicycle) and ⟦{二輪車|にりんしゃ}→二輪車：20952_nirinsha⟧ (two-wheeled vehicle/motorcycle).

USAGE:
Most commonly refers to children's pedal tricycles. Can also refer to three-wheeled motorized vehicles, which were common in Japan during the postwar era for deliveries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三輪車|さんりんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ — to ride a tricycle
- {三輪車|さんりんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こぐ — to pedal a tricycle
- {子供用|こどもよう}{三輪車|さんりんしゃ} — children's tricycle

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧ — bicycle
- ⟦{二輪車|にりんしゃ}→二輪車：20952_nirinsha⟧ — two-wheeled vehicle, motorcycle
- ⟦{一輪車|いちりんしゃ}→一輪車：15186_ichirinsha⟧ — unicycle; wheelbarrow
